findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_feed_status, get_fba_customer_returns, get_listing, get_account_health, get_listing_issues, list_inactive_listings, audit_compliance, get_aplus_document, get_dashboard_data, get_vendor_invoices, send_feedback · Private data: get_epr_report, get_account_health, check_listing_restrictions, list_aplus_documents, get_aplus_document, get_context_document, execute_sql · Public sink: get_inbound_plans, create_inbound_plan, get_vendor_invoices, send_feedback · Destructive: audit_catalog_quality, create_listing, update_listing, delete_listing, bulk_delete_listings, update_item_highlights, ads_update_sp_audience_bidding, ads_delete_sp_campaign, ads_delete_sp_negative_keywords, ads_delete_sp_targets, ads_delete_sp_negative_targets, diagnose_sales_drop, execute_sql.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_feed_status, get_fba_customer_returns, get_listing, get_account_health, get_listing_issues, list_inactive_listings, audit_compliance, get_aplus_document, get_dashboard_data, get_vendor_invoices, send_feedback · Private data: get_epr_report, get_account_health, check_listing_restrictions, list_aplus_documents, get_aplus_document, get_context_document, execute_sql · Public sink: get_inbound_plans, create_inbound_plan, get_vendor_invoices, send_feedback · Destructive: audit_catalog_quality, create_listing, update_listing, delete_listing, bulk_delete_listings, update_item_highlights, ads_update_sp_audience_bidding, ads_delete_sp_campaign, ads_delete_sp_negative_keywords, ads_delete_sp_targets, ads_delete_sp_negative_targets, diagnose_sales_drop, execute_sql

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
